newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - BANGLADESH NEWSPAPERS - AUG 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - BANGLADESH NEWSPAPERS - AUG 14.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The government has decided to install sculptures at different points of the capital Dhaka.
Lightning on Wednesday killed three fishermen and injured two others in the river Padma
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Wednesday said the opposition BNP's threat for anti-government agitation was aimed at foiling the trial of the killers of independence leader Sheikh Mujibur Rahman.

Deputy Chief Minister of Indian state of Tripura Baddyanath Majumder has said the state government will start erection of the planned barbed-wire fence along the 800 kilometre border with Banglasdesh to prevent insurgency activities.
Bangladesh will observe August 15 as the National Mourning Day, marking the assassination of indepenence leader Sheikh Mujibur Rahman.
Opposition leader Begum Khaleda Zia on Wednesday said people could no longer carry out their business and service smoothly because of what she said was misrule of the government.
Germany will provide DM 80 million to Bangladesh for financing different infrastructural and social programmes.
Jute prices in the local market have tumbled to around 150 taka per maund against last year's 350 taka. REUTER
